blurb: Guests can visit the Worcester taproom for beer, cocktails, and food in a fresh, laid-back space. The brewery hosts private events including birthday dinners, wedding receptions, corporate networking, and fundraisers with tailored menus and beverage options. They also offer a rewards program for non-alcoholic purchases and regularly feature live music events.
extraNote: No outside food or beverages allowed for private events · Reserve private event dates as soon as possible; first come, first serve · Worcester Taproom at 100 Shrewsbury St, Worcester, MA
